newsitem.title: FRANCE: French call money unchanged at 3-1/8 1/4 percent.
newsitem.headline: French call money unchanged at 3-1/8 1/4 percent.

text.p: - French call money, a semi-official overnight interest rate, was unchanged at 3-1/8 1/4 percent on Monday, traders said.
It was last lowered on January 31, the day after the Bank of France cut the intervention rate, which sets the floor for French money market rates, to 3.10 percent.
French financial markets came under pressure on Monday after the opposition left outpolled the ruling centre-right coalition in the first round of voting in a French parliamentary election.
